name: Vegeta
description: Versatile HTTP load testing tool and Go library designed to drill HTTP services with constant request rate, avoiding Coordinated Omission issues.

docker_support.docker_evidence: Dockerfile present; community Docker images: peter-evans/vegeta-docker, dannykansas/vegeta-docker

eval_notes: HTTP load testing with constant request rate and accurate latency measurement (25k+ stars). CLI and library usage. Excellent for benchmarking API endpoints in 5G core network evaluation scenarios.
